name: 男の子（赤パーカー）
prompt: Outfit swap over the base sheet (avatar.boy-basic) via Cloudflare AI Gateway (gateway kaede-assets, unified billing) with google/nano-banana-2, image_input = the base character's committed green-screen sheet (~$0.10, first try accepted — the ①b(a) layer-composition spike, 2026-08-08, candidate (a) of ROADMAP ①b 着手順⑵: reference+edit over the existing sheet, no video-line re-run needed). Prompt: 'This image is a sprite sheet of 5 frames of the same chibi boy game character on a flat pure green #00FF00 chroma-key background: standing, then 4 walk-cycle frames. Edit ONLY his clothes: replace the white short-sleeved shirt with a RED hooded sweatshirt (hoodie, long sleeves, a small hood resting on his back, a front pocket), and replace the navy pants with BEIGE chino pants. Keep everything else EXACTLY pixel-identical in every frame: the same face, the same eyes, the same hair, the same skin, the same brown shoes, the same body poses, the same arm and leg positions, the same frame layout and spacing, the same flat pure green background. Do not move, resize or redraw the character poses. The long sleeves must follow the existing arm poses exactly; hands stay bare skin. Same cute chibi cartoon style, clean bold outlines, soft cel shading, constant even lighting, no shadows.' Pose fidelity was verified mechanically before import: per-frame silhouette IoU against the base sheet (height-normalized, bottom-center aligned) measured 0.916-0.956, i.e. poses, ground contact and head match the base outfit — the residual difference is the clothes' own silhouette (hood, sleeve length). Note the model returned a different canvas resolution (1680x637 vs 1900x720); the import line's stand-height normalization absorbs that. This edit-over-sheet path preserved the walk alternation, unlike the bench's restyle-over-raw-video-frames attempt which drifted the poses back to one stride — editing an already-composed sheet with a keep-everything instruction is the pose-safe way to use nano-banana-2.
